models._comment: When using ISTA IQ3_S with mtp:1 and rocm, a 64K context is what could fit in vram on a 16GB dedicated amdgpu
models._thinking: This model's chat template (llama.cpp) validates reasoning_effort and only accepts low, medium, xhigh: 'off' or 'minimal' raise a Jinja exception (HTTP 500). So off/minimal are spelled as 'low' and thinking is turned off with chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false, which this template understands (and Strata's OpenAI path also honors). It lives under the off/minimal keys of samplingParamsByThinkingLevel, so the real low/medium/xhigh caps are untouched; samplingParams is applied last and verbatim.

models._comment: The minimal thinking level is currently required for pi-web to summarize the session title since it disables thinking for Flash, otherwise the 24 tokens limit requested to the model fail and pi-web just do a text truncation.
models._thinking: minimal is mapped to Strata's own no-thinking spelling ('off') instead of 'minimal', so off and minimal produce identical requests: pi-web's title call (hardcoded reasoning: 'minimal', maxTokens 24) sends reasoning_effort 'off' and the 24 tokens go to the title. Setting minimal to null would hide it from the picker, but pi then clamps the title call upward to 'low', which thinks and truncates.
